content:
I can answer questions about sexual health, biology, relationships, education, and related topics in an informative and straightforward way.

What I aim to avoid is generating explicit sexual content, erotica, or content sexualizing minors.

If you have a question, feel free to ask and I'll do my best to be helpful.
